info.title: Toy Mart BD API
info.description: Toy Mart BD API v1, grouped by audience: storefront, admin, webhooks. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`, schema `ProblemDetails`); branch on `type`, never on `title`/`detail`. Routes marked with the `Idempotency-Key` header replay a completed 2xx response for 24h (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`).

BannerPlacement.description: Banner slots outside the homepage blocks (the home hero is a CMS block). - announcement_bar: the strip above the header. - category_page: under a category page's header; optionally targeted at one category. - info_strip: a plain information line (delivery cut-off, holiday notice). The ONLY   placement that may render on cart and checkout, and it is text-only there (rule 25b:   checkout carries no upsell or cross-sell). - popup: a dismissible notice; never on cart or checkout.
BannerPlacement.title: BannerPlacement

BannerRequest.description:
`POST /content/banners` and `PUT /content/banners/{banner}` — the whole banner. `starts_at` /
`ends_at` are ISO 8601 instants (the admin sends Dhaka time with +06:00); stored UTC.

Placement rules: only `category_page` and `popup` take an image (`media_id`, a library
image); only `category_page` targets a `category_id`; `info_strip` — the only placement shown
on cart and checkout — is text plus at most a link to a static page (`/pages/…`), never a
product or category (rule 25b).
BannerRequest.title: BannerRequest

BlockType.description:
Every CMS block type. Each has one JSON schema (BlockSchema): its validation rules, its defaults for a freshly added block, and its normaliser (sanitising rich text, dropping unknown keys). The storefront has one component per type (components/content/blocks/**). | | |---| | `hero`
Hero / banner carousel: 1–5 slides; the first slide's image is the page's LCP. | | `category_tiles`
| | `age_tiles`
"Shop by age" tiles with live counts from the catalogue. | | `product_rail`
Product rail by rule: new, best sellers, category, brand or a manual pick. | | `flash_sale`
Slot for the running flash sale (Marketing); the storefront fills it and hides it when none runs. | | `brand_strip`
| | `usp_band`
| | `promo_split`
| | `testimonials`
Slot filled from the testimonials table (Content testimonials). | | `blog_teaser`
Slot filled from the latest live blog posts (Content blog). | | `rich_text`
| | `faq`
Questions and answers; the storefront emits FAQPage JSON-LD for it. |
BlockType.title: BlockType

BlogPostRequest.description:
`POST /blog/posts` and `PUT /blog/posts/{post}` — the whole post document (a save replaces it).

- `publish_at` is Dhaka wall time `Y-m-d H:i` (or ISO 8601 with an offset, the content screens'
  convention), required for `status: scheduled` and in the future; the server stores it as UTC.
- `body`/`body_bn` and section bodies are editor HTML, sanitised on save.
- `sections` apply to a buying guide only; each pick is a product id. `related_product_ids`
  are the post's manual related products (≤ 8). Picks of an unbuyable product are kept and
  hidden on the storefront.
- `seo` omitted keeps the saved seo_meta; sent, only the keys it carries change (the SEO
  module's full panel, `PUT /seo/meta/blog_post/{id}`, owns the rest).

publish_at.description: Dhaka wall time `Y-m-d H:i`, or ISO 8601 with an offset (`2026-12-01T00:00:00+06:00`).

BlogPostRequest.title: BlogPostRequest

BlogTermRequest.description:
Create or edit a blog category (`/blog/categories`), tag (`/blog/tags`) or author
(`/blog/authors`). `slug` omitted keeps the current one (new: generated from the name).
`description(_bn)` is a category description or an author bio; `position` is for
categories, `avatar_media_id` and `user_id` for authors.
BlogTermRequest.title: BlogTermRequest

BulkConfirmOrdersRequest.description:
`POST /orders/bulk/confirm` — needs orders.confirm. Up to 100 ids (one board page is
25). Unknown ids are not a validation error: they come back as `not_found` results,
so a stale selection still reports per order.
BulkConfirmOrdersRequest.title: BulkConfirmOrdersRequest

BulkFulfilOrdersRequest.description:
`POST /orders/bulk/ship` and `POST /orders/bulk/deliver` — manual fulfilment of many
orders from the board. Needs orders.update + shipments.book. Up to 100 ids; unknown ids
come back as `not_found` results. `courier_name` (ship only) applies to every order.

courier_name.description: Bulk ship only: the courier every parcel was handed to. Ignored by bulk deliver.

BulkFulfilOrdersRequest.title: BulkFulfilOrdersRequest

BulkMediaRequest.description:
`POST /media/bulk/delete` and `POST /media/bulk/download` — `{ ids }`, 1–200 distinct
integers. Both need media.delete (deleteAny). Delete reports unknown ids as
`not_found`; the zip refuses them (422 on `ids.N`).
BulkMediaRequest.title: BulkMediaRequest

BulkMoveMediaRequest.description:
`POST /media/bulk/move` — `{ ids, folder_id }`: 1–200 distinct existing media ids and
a folder id, or null to un-file. Needs media.manage.
BulkMoveMediaRequest.title: BulkMoveMediaRequest

BulkPackOrdersRequest.description:
`POST /orders/bulk/pack` — mark many orders packed (→ ready to ship), needs
orders.update. Up to 100 ids; unknown ids come back as `not_found` results.
BulkPackOrdersRequest.title: BulkPackOrdersRequest

BulkRequestShipmentsRequest.description:
`POST /shipments/bulk` — send many orders to one courier from the board. Needs
orders.update + shipments.book; `Idempotency-Key` required. Up to 100 ids; unknown ids
come back as `not_found` results.

provider.description: Courier provider code. Omitted: the active default provider.

BulkRequestShipmentsRequest.title: BulkRequestShipmentsRequest

CancelOrderRequest.description:
`POST /orders/{order}/cancel` — needs orders.cancel. `reason` is the fixed list
(cancellations are counted by cause); `note` is required when the reason is `other`.
CancelOrderRequest.title: CancelOrderRequest

CancelShipmentRequest.description: `POST /shipments/{shipment}/cancel` — only pending or failed shipments; needs shipments.cancel.
CancelShipmentRequest.title: CancelShipmentRequest

CancellationReason.description: Why an order was cancelled (P4-ORD-09). A fixed list so cancellations can be counted by cause; `Other` requires a free-text note. Feeds the risk profile through OrderCancelled — `FakeOrder` and `CustomerUnreachable` are the signals that matter there.
CancellationReason.title: CancellationReason

token.description: Opaque cart token: store it in an httpOnly cookie and send it back as `X-Cart-Token`.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601, UTC. Extended by every change.

items.description:
One entry per line. `sellable` false: the item can no longer be bought (it is
excluded from every total; remove it). `in_stock` false: `quantity` exceeds
`available_quantity` (checkout will refuse until it is lowered). `image` is the
variant's own photo, else the product's primary, else its first (a 160px rendition;
null until one is processed). `variant.attributes` are the variant-defining values,
in attribute order (e.g. Colour: Red), each with its Bangla label when set.

coupon.description:
The coupon on the cart, if any. `applied` false: `reason` (stable code) and
`message` (localised) say why; the cart keeps it so the customer sees why.

adjustments.description:
Signed rows in pipeline order (subtotal, each promotion and the coupon as
negatives, then delivery) that sum exactly to `totals.grand_total`.

totals.description:
`shipping_charge` is null without a destination (`?district_id=`) or when it is not
serviced; `grand_total` then excludes delivery.

anyOf.description: The delivery quote for the requested destination — the same object `GET /delivery-quote` returns, for this cart.

checkout_ready.description: Every line sellable and in stock, the coupon (if any) applied and a serviced destination given.

CategoryStatus.description: `categories.status`. A category is archived rather than deleted, because products reference it through `primary_category_id` and `category_product`.
CategoryStatus.title: CategoryStatus

CheckoutRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/checkout` (P4-STO-09, docs/api/checkout.md). The cart comes from
`X-Cart-Token`; the body is what the customer typed plus `expected_total`, the grand
total they were shown — compared, never used, by PlaceOrder.

Address: division → district → upazila → area + line + landmark (rule 31). The
upazila is required unless the district offers its city as the empty option
(`city_option` on GET /districts — Dhaka city is not an upazila).

payment_method.description: `cod`, or an online method `GET /payment-methods` lists as enabled (P4-PAY-02).

expected_total.description: The grand total the customer was shown, e.g. "1930.00".

CheckoutRequest.title: CheckoutRequest

ClosePurchaseRequest.description:
`POST /purchases/{purchase}/close` — close a partly received PO short; needs
purchasing.create (like cancelling) and a reason. 409 unless partially received.

reason.description: Why the rest will not arrive (supplier out of stock, discontinued …).

ClosePurchaseRequest.title: ClosePurchaseRequest

path.description: Locale-free storefront path.

seo.description: Stored seo_meta overrides plus the defaults an empty field falls back to.

CmsPageRequest.description:
`POST /content/pages` and `PUT /content/pages/{page}` — the whole page document. `slug` null
keeps the current slug (or generates one from the title). `published_at` is an ISO 8601
instant (the admin sends Dhaka time with its +06:00 offset); with `status: published` a
future instant schedules the page. Changing a live page's slug needs
`acknowledge_slug_redirect: true` — the old URL then 301s (slug_history).

content.description: Rich text (HTML from the admin editor); sanitised on save.

seo.description: Search & social (seo_meta, type `page`). Omitted: keep; sent: replace.

CmsPageRequest.title: CmsPageRequest

note.description: Shown on the order's activity timeline next to the change.

batch.description: Bulk-generated codes share a batch label (coupon builder, P7).

CouponType.description:
`coupons.type` (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.8). | | |---| | `fixed`
`value` taka off the eligible goods, never more than they cost. | | `percent`
`value` percent off the eligible goods, capped at `max_discount`. | | `free_shipping`
Delivery becomes free (DATABASE-DESIGN §5.1 step 1); goods are not discounted. |
CouponType.title: CouponType

is_active.description: False once the courier stopped returning this row; a mapping on it no longer books.

mapped.description: Active rows a human has mapped.

mapped_inactive.description: Mapped rows the courier no longer serves — bookings there are blocked until re-mapped.

provider.description: The provider filter, or null for every courier.

districts.description: `district` null = shipments whose order has no district.

upazila_id.description: Null for a district-level place (an address with no upazila, such as Dhaka city).

waiting_orders.description: Open orders (not yet shipped) addressed here — what booking through this courier would block.

mapped_count.description: Courier rows a human has mapped to exactly this place.

verified.description: A booking has succeeded through this driver (rule 33a). Set by the booking flow, never by this screen.

requires_location_mapping.description: Booking needs a mapped courier_locations row (Pathao yes, Steadfast no — rule 32).

credential_fields.description: The provider's credential keys; `hint` is "••••1234" at most.

webhook_url.description: The URL to register in the courier's merchant panel.

balance.description: Last balance the provider reported; null = never checked.

score.description: 0–1 name similarity (city ~ district, zone ~ upazila). Not a confidence in the mapping.

CropProductImageRequest.description:
`POST /products/{product}/images/{image}/crop` — `{ x, y, width, height }` in the
image's current pixels (`width` × `height` on the resource). Needs catalog.update.
CropProductImageRequest.title: CropProductImageRequest

DeliverOrderRequest.description:
`POST /orders/{order}/deliver` — manual delivery confirmation (P5, until Phase 6
courier status updates). Needs orders.update + shipments.book.

note.description: Shown on the order's activity timeline next to the change.

DeliverOrderRequest.title: DeliverOrderRequest

upazila_required.description: The district alone does not settle the charge: ask for the upazila.

subtotal.description: The goods value the quote is for (variant price × quantity).

charge.description: What the customer pays for delivery — "0.00" when free.

standard_charge.description:
base_charge + weight_surcharge: the charge before any free delivery (struck
through when free).

free_shipping.description:
`progress_percent` is the subtotal as a whole percent of the threshold (0–100,
rounded down) for the free-delivery meter; null when there is no threshold.

cod_advance.description: Advance payment a COD order of this value needs in this zone, or null.

free_shipping_threshold.description: Subtotal at or above which delivery is free in every zone; null = off.

ExpenseCategoryRequest.description:
An expense category, for `POST /finance/expense-categories` and `PATCH …/{category}`.
`parent_id` must be a top-level category (one level of nesting) and not itself.
`ledger_type` (optional) names the ledger type its expenses post as.
ExpenseCategoryRequest.title: ExpenseCategoryRequest

ExpenseDecisionRequest.description:
`POST /finance/expenses/{expense}/approve|reject|void`. Reject and void need a `reason`
(kept on the expense); approve takes none. The ability checked is the route's action.
ExpenseDecisionRequest.title: ExpenseDecisionRequest

ExpensePaymentMethod.description: How an expense was paid. A null `payment_method` means not paid yet (an accrual).
ExpensePaymentMethod.title: ExpensePaymentMethod

ExpenseReceiptRequest.description: `POST /finance/expenses/{expense}/receipt` — multipart `receipt`: a PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP ≤ 10 MB (by content).
ExpenseReceiptRequest.title: ExpenseReceiptRequest

ExpenseRecurrence.description: `expenses.recurrence` of a recurring template: generated on the 1st of each due month (Dhaka).
ExpenseRecurrence.title: ExpenseRecurrence

ExpenseRequest.description:
The expense document, for `POST /finance/expenses` (JSON or `multipart/form-data` with an
optional `receipt` file) and `PATCH /finance/expenses/{expense}` (JSON; the receipt has its
own endpoint). Money is a decimal string > 0. Dates are Dhaka dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and an
expense cannot be dated in the future. A null `payment_method` means "not paid yet".
ExpenseRequest.title: ExpenseRequest

Gender.description: `products.gender` — nullable: most toys need no gender at all.
Gender.title: Gender

GenerateCouponsRequest.description:
`POST /coupons/generate` (coupon builder, P7) — the coupon document without `code`,
plus `count` (1–1000), `prefix` (optional, ≤ 12), `code_length` (6–16, default 8) and
`batch` (the campaign label the codes share). Needs marketing.manage.
GenerateCouponsRequest.title: GenerateCouponsRequest

last_courier_sync.description:
Courier sync lands in Phase 6 (Fulfilment). Always null until then, and never
counted towards `status`.

HoldOrderRequest.description:
`POST /orders/{order}/hold` — needs orders.update. A hold always says why (`reason`),
so whoever picks the order up next knows what is being waited on.

reason.description: Why the order is paused, e.g. "Customer asked to deliver after Friday".

HoldOrderRequest.title: HoldOrderRequest

ImportSettlementRequest.description:
`POST /finance/settlements` — import one courier remittance: `provider` (courier code),
`reference` (the courier's payment id), `received_at` (Dhaka date, not in the future),
optional `period_start`/`period_end` (both or neither; enables MISSING-line detection) and
`note`; then EITHER `file` (the portal export, CSV or XLSX, ≤ 5 MB) OR `lines[]` typed in
(`consignment_id`, `cod_amount`, optional `delivery_charge`, `cod_fee`, `return_charge`,
`net_amount`; ≤ 500). Needs finance.reconcile_cod and an `Idempotency-Key`.
ImportSettlementRequest.title: ImportSettlementRequest

InspectReturnRequest.description:
`POST /returns/{orderReturn}/inspect` — needs returns.manage. One row per returned line:
how many units are resellable and how many damaged; they must add up to the line's
returned quantity (checked by InspectReturn).
InspectReturnRequest.title: InspectReturnRequest

status.description:
`applied` (below the approval threshold, moved at once), `pending` (waiting for
approval, nothing moved), `approved` (moved when approved), `rejected` (never moved).

moved_stock.description: Whether this adjustment has written its stock movements.

requested_units.description: Units the request changes (absolute, summed) — what the approval threshold reads.

requested_value.description: Their value at weighted-average cost, 2 dp; only with catalog.view_cost.

items.description:
One per variant. `quantity_before`/`after` and `change` are provisional while pending
(re-read under the lock on approval) and final once moved.

difference.description: actual − expected, for a drift alert.

alert_date.description: The Dhaka calendar day it was raised, YYYY-MM-DD.

location_id.description: The location counted — the default one.

count.description: Variants with 0 < available ≤ reorder point there (up to a minute old).

unit_cost.description: Unit cost the units moved at, 4 dp; only with catalog.view_cost.

reference_type.description: The source document: `stock_adjustment`, `stock_transfer`, `product` (opening stock), and later order, purchase, shipment, refund.

reference_number.description: The document's human number where it has one (ADJ-2026-0012, TRF-2026-0003).

adjustment_reason.description: The adjustment's reason, for an adjustment movement.

user_name.description: Staff member who recorded it; null for the system.

opening.description: On hand before the period (0 without `from`).

variants_checked.description: Variants (with a stock level in scope) whose ledger was checked.

drift_variant_ids.description: Up to 50 variant ids whose ledger sum differs from on_hand.

balanced.description: True when the ledger matches the stock levels for every variant in scope.

stock_value.description: Current stock value at cost in scope; only with catalog.view_cost.

available.description: on_hand − reserved. May be negative only if the ledger has drifted.

reorder_quantity.description: Units a reorder brings in; 0 = not set (the variant is then never overstock).

state.description:
`out` (available ≤ 0), `low` (0 < available ≤ reorder point), `overstock`
(reorder quantity set and available > reorder point + 2 × reorder quantity) or null.

unit_cost.description: Unit cost basis (weighted-average cost, else current cost price), 4 dp; only with catalog.view_cost.

value.description: on_hand × unit cost, 2 dp; only with catalog.view_cost.

elsewhere.description:
On hand and available at every other active location, in location order
(empty while there is only one location).

transfer_from.description:
For a low or out-of-stock row: the other location with the most units
available, the source a transfer would draw from; null when no other
location has any, or the row is not short.

location_id.description: The location the counts and the on-hand figures are for.

counts.description: Rows per tab: every variant, low (0 < available ≤ reorder point), out (available ≤ 0), overstock (reorder quantity set and available > reorder point + 2 × reorder quantity), idle (stock but no movement for 90 days).

reserved.description: Units held for open orders, not yet shipped.

value.description: Stock value at cost at this location; only with catalog.view_cost.

total_value.description: Stock value at cost across every active location; only with catalog.view_cost.

locations.description: Every active location, the default first. `value` only with catalog.view_cost.

status.description: Booked in one step: no in-transit state.

as_at.description: The Dhaka date valued (end of that day); null = the live projection.

data.description:
`unit_cost` is 4 dp; `value` = on_hand × unit_cost, 2 dp. `estimated` = as-at
row whose movements carried no cost, valued at today's cost basis.

IssueCmsPreviewTokenRequest.description: `POST /content/home/preview-token` — `locale` en|bn picks the storefront prefix of the preview URL.
IssueCmsPreviewTokenRequest.title: IssueCmsPreviewTokenRequest

LandedCostMethod.description: How a receipt's landed costs (freight, customs/duty, other) are split across its lines. `value` is the default and what DATABASE-DESIGN §3.2 specifies; `quantity` suits a shipment of similar items, `weight` a freight bill charged by the kilo (needs every line's `product_variants.weight_grams`).
LandedCostMethod.title: LandedCostMethod

MapCourierLocationRequest.description:
`PUT /courier-locations/{provider}/{location}/mapping` — a human maps one courier zone
or area to our district (+ upazila). The only way a row becomes mapped (rule 32). The
upazila must belong to the district, and the row must still be served by the provider.
Needs shipments.manage_locations.

upazila_id.description: Omit (or null) for a district-level mapping — an address with no upazila, such as Dhaka city.

MapCourierLocationRequest.title: MapCourierLocationRequest

MarginPreviewRequest.description:
`POST /products/margin-preview` — margins for prices and costs the form has not
saved yet, so the admin never computes one (rule 1). Needs catalog.view_cost.
Money is a decimal string; `rows[i]` answers `rows[i]`.
MarginPreviewRequest.title: MarginPreviewRequest

MediaFolderRequest.description:
`POST /media/folders` and `PATCH /media/folders/{folder}` — `{ name }`, 1–60
characters after trimming. Uniqueness (case-insensitive) is checked by the Action
under a lock. Needs media.manage.
MediaFolderRequest.title: MediaFolderRequest

MenuLocation.description: Where a menu renders. Each location caps how deep items may nest: the header mega menu has three levels (tab → column → link), the footer two (column → link), the mobile menu two.
MenuLocation.title: MenuLocation

sms_cost_per_segment.description: Decimal string, taka per SMS segment (PLACEHOLDER until a contract).

whatsapp_enabled.description: Order updates go WhatsApp-first. Off until a WhatsApp account exists.

MoveCategoryRequest.description:
`POST /categories/{category}/move` — `{ parent_id, position }`. The category
becomes the child of `parent_id` (null = a root) at sibling index `position`
(0-based; past the end means last). Up/down keeps the parent and changes the
position; indent/outdent changes the parent.
MoveCategoryRequest.title: MoveCategoryRequest

required_variables.description: Positional parameters a WhatsApp system body must keep (Meta-approved).

cost_en.description: Cost of one SMS send at the configured per-segment rate, server-computed; null for WhatsApp and email.

missing_variables.description: Parameters a WhatsApp system body dropped (Meta-approved; refused on save).

warnings.description: An SMS side that runs to 3+ segments.

anomaly.description: Why this status combination should not exist, or null (spec A12).

gateway_reference.description: Online gateway ids and state (P4-PAY-02/03); null/false for COD. @var string|null

flags.description: Our advisory signals as stored at scoring time — never a courier's data (rule 24).

profile.description:
The phone's CURRENT profile (P6 risk module): our score now and the staff list
status — beside, never merged with, the snapshot above (rule 24).

available_actions.description:
What this user may do to the order now — the state machine and their permissions,
decided here so the client never re-derives a transition rule.

editable.description: Whether this user may edit the order now (P4-ORD-07: pre-packing status and orders.update).

can_print_invoice.description: Whether this user may print the invoice / packing slip (orders.view + customers.view_pii).

phone.description: E.164 — the number as it will be stored.

OrderInvoicesRequest.description:
`POST /orders/bulk/invoices` and `GET /orders/{order}/invoice` — the invoice /
packing-slip PDF (P4-ORD-08). Needs orders.view AND customers.view_pii: the slip
carries the full phone and street address the rider needs. `locale` picks the
language (default: each customer's preferred language).
OrderInvoicesRequest.title: OrderInvoicesRequest

anomaly.description: Why this status combination should not exist, or null (spec A12 anomaly list).

shipping_charge.description: null without a destination, or when it is not serviced

OrderQuoteRequest.description:
`POST /orders/quote` — price a new staff order through the checkout pipeline without
writing anything (P4-ORD-06). Needs orders.create. Everything but the lines is
optional: without a district there is no delivery line; without a phone the
per-customer coupon checks wait for the save.

phone.description: Optional; enables the per-customer and first-order coupon checks. Ignored when not a valid number yet.

OrderQuoteRequest.title: OrderQuoteRequest

value.description: Σ unit price × quantity returned, for the list's VALUE column (the refund itself is `refund.amount`).

has_refund.description: A refund exists (shown in `refund` only with refunds.view).

OrderTrackRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/orders/track` (P4-STO-10, rule 22): order number **plus** phone
digits — the last 4 (B7.1) or the full number. The number is forgiving about case,
spaces, the `TMB-` prefix and Bengali digits.

phone.description: The last 4 digits of the phone the order was placed with, or the full number.

OrderTrackRequest.title: OrderTrackRequest

OrderWorkflowRequest.description:
Release from hold, start processing, mark ready to ship — needs orders.update. An
optional `note` lands on the order's timeline row with the move.

note.description: Shown on the order's activity timeline next to the change.

OrderWorkflowRequest.title: OrderWorkflowRequest

PageStatus.description: `cms_pages.status`. A published page with a future `published_at` is scheduled.
PageStatus.title: PageStatus

PageTemplate.description: How the storefront lays a static page out. `faq` renders `faq_items` as an accordion.
PageTemplate.title: PageTemplate

PayExpenseRequest.description: `POST /finance/expenses/{expense}/pay` — `payment_method` and `paid_on` (a Dhaka date, not in the future).
PayExpenseRequest.title: PayExpenseRequest

PayRefundRequest.description:
`POST /refunds/{refund}/pay` — refunds.create or refunds.approve; needs an
`Idempotency-Key`. For a COD (or cash) order staff paid by hand: `method` (bkash, nagad,
cash, bank_transfer) and the transaction `reference` (not needed for cash) are required
then (checked by PayRefund). For an online payment both are ignored — the gateway pays.
PayRefundRequest.title: PayRefundRequest

PhoneLookupRequest.description:
`GET /risk/lookup?phone=…` and `POST /risk/lookup/rescore` — a Bangladesh mobile number
in any accepted spelling (rule 30). Lookup needs risk.view; rescore needs risk.verify
(it writes the profile projection).
PhoneLookupRequest.title: PhoneLookupRequest

buckets.description: One bucket per period, oldest first, including empty ones.

blocks.description:
The five blocks in order. A `line` carries the ledger types it sums; a
`subtotal` is the running total after the lines above it.

gross_margin_percent.description: Gross profit as % of net revenue, 2 dp; null without revenue.

net_margin_percent.description: Net profit as % of net revenue, 2 dp; null without revenue.

unmapped.description:
Recognised entries of a type that does not belong in a P&L (e.g. a cash-only
type flagged as revenue). Not counted above; should always be empty.

expenses_by_category.description: Recognised entries with an expense category, per category, largest cost first.

cash.description: Cash movements in the period (`is_cash_movement`), kept apart from the P&L.

reconciliation.description:
Recognised net split by whether the entry belongs to an order. `reconciled` is
true when the two parts add up to the statement's net profit.

open_orders.description:
Orders placed and not yet delivered, cancelled or returned — current, not per
period. Not in the statement.

inventory_at_cost.description: Inventory on hand at cost, now; only with catalog.view_cost. Not in the statement.

comparison.description: The comparison period's subtotals and the % change of each; null when `compare=none`.

source.description: Where the figures were read from.

PostStatus.description: A post's editorial state. Live on the storefront = not draft and `published_at` reached: a scheduled post goes live at its instant even before the sweep flips it to `published`.
PostStatus.title: PostStatus

PostType.description: An article, or a buying guide (structured sections with product picks), served under /guides.
PostType.title: PostType

PreviewNotificationTemplateRequest.description:
`POST /notifications/templates/{template}/preview` — measure an unsaved body (the
editor's live character/segment/cost counter). Writes nothing; needs settings.view.
PreviewNotificationTemplateRequest.title: PreviewNotificationTemplateRequest

type.description: Stable machine-readable problem type, e.g. `https://toymartbd.com/problems/validation-error`. Branch on this.

description.description:
Sanitised rich-text HTML: p, h2, h3, strong, em, ul, ol, li, blockquote, br,
a[href] and img[src, alt, width, height] from our own media only.

description_bn.description:
Sanitised rich-text HTML: p, h2, h3, strong, em, ul, ol, li, blockquote, br,
a[href] and img[src, alt, width, height] from our own media only.

is_live.description:
Live on the storefront now (active and `published_at` reached): its slug
changes only with `acknowledge_slug_redirect`.

sales_channels.description: Where the product is sold (stored flags).

vat_rate.description: VAT included in the selling price, percent, decimal string ("0.00").

compliance.description:
BSTI certification. `certificate` is the uploaded PDF (download it from
`GET /products/{product}/compliance/certificate`), null when none.
`expired`: the expiry date is before today (Dhaka).

margin.description:
Margin of the default variant (a simple product's price), computed by the
server; only with catalog.view_cost. Null when its price or cost is not set.

margin_lowest.description:
The lowest variant margin (archived variants included) and its variant;
only with catalog.view_cost. Null when no variant has a margin.

stock_by_location.description:
Stock of all the product's variants per location (on hand, reserved,
available); only with inventory.view. Read-only — change it with a stock
adjustment.

slug_history.description: Retired slugs that now 301 to this product (newest first).

seo.description: Search & social (seo_meta), with the server's defaults, measurement and checklist.

options.description:
The selected values of each variant-defining attribute, derived from the
active variants. Empty for a simple product.

create_count.description: Rows that create (preview: would create) a product.

update_count.description: Rows that update (preview: would update) a product.

error_count.description: Rows with at least one problem; they are not written.

row.description: Spreadsheet row number (the header is row 1); 0 for a problem with the file itself.

column.description: The column the problem belongs to; null for the row (or file) as a whole.

related_product.description:
`image_url`: the primary image's 160 px rendition (null when none is ready);
`price`: the default variant's selling price, decimal string.

ProductScopeType.description: What a coupon or promotion applies to (`coupons.applies_to`, promotion `rules.scope.applies_to`).
ProductScopeType.title: ProductScopeType

defaults.description: What an empty override falls back to.

url.description: The canonical storefront URL of the product.

measure.description:
Estimated rendered widths of the effective title and description at Google's
desktop metric (see POST /products/seo-measure for unsaved text).

checklist.description:
The saved product's SEO checklist. `key` ∈ title_fits, description_fits,
primary_image, image_alt, slug, product_schema, sitemap.

schema.description: The effective Product JSON-LD (generated, with `schema_override` merged on top).

ProductStatus.description: `products.status`. `draft` is invisible to the storefront; `active` is live once `published_at` has passed; `archived` is retired but kept (orders reference it).
ProductStatus.title: ProductStatus

ProductType.description: `products.type`. A simple product has exactly one (default) variant; a variable product has one variant per combination of its selected attribute values. Either way the variant is the unit of inventory (DATABASE-DESIGN §1.1).
ProductType.title: ProductType

cost_price.description: Current replacement cost; only with catalog.view_cost.

margin.description:
Per-unit margin at this price and cost, VAT taken out, before delivery and COD
costs — computed by the server. Only with catalog.view_cost; null when the
price or the cost is not set.

stock.description:
Current stock at all locations; only with inventory.view. Read-only here:
opening stock is set on create (`opening_stock`), later changes are
stock adjustments (Phase 5).

attribute_values.description: One value per variant-defining attribute; empty for a simple product.

totals.description: Over every row, not only the returned ones.

PromotionType.description:
`promotions.type` (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.8). `rules` shape per type is documented in docs/api/promotions.md and read by {@see \App\Domain\Marketing\Services\PromotionEngine}. | | |---| | `discount`
Percent or fixed-per-unit off every eligible line (the general "percentage / fixed" promotion). | | `flash_sale`
Hard-windowed sale. With `flash_sale_items` rows: each listed variant at its sale price for a limited allotment. Without: percent/fixed like `discount` (Phase 4 rows). | | `category_discount`
As `discount`; the Phase 4 name, kept so existing rows and reports still read. | | `tiered`
Percent or fixed off the eligible subtotal, by the highest tier reached. | | `buy_x_get_y`
For every `buy` + `get` eligible units, the `get` cheapest are discounted by `percent`. | | `bundle`
Percent or fixed off — or a fixed `price` for — each complete set of `product_ids`. | | `free_delivery`
Delivery becomes free when the eligible goods (after discounts) reach `min_subtotal`. |
PromotionType.title: PromotionType

PublishCmsLayoutRequest.description: `POST /content/home/publish` — an optional note for the version history.
PublishCmsLayoutRequest.title: PublishCmsLayoutRequest

closed_at.description: When a partly received PO was closed short.

landed_unit_cost.description: Quantity-weighted landed cost over every receipt so far, 4 dp; null before the first.

costs_vendor.description: Who charged the landed costs when not the supplier.

payable_amount.description: What the supplier is owed for this delivery.

ReceivePurchaseRequest.description:
`POST /purchases/{purchase}/receipts` and `…/receipts/quote` — the units arriving per
PO line, where they go, and the landed costs to split across them. The quote takes
the same body and returns every figure the receipt would write; needs
purchasing.receive. Over-receipt and unknown lines are 422s from ReceiptCalculator.

location_id.description: Where the goods are put away; the PO's location when omitted.

quantity.description: Units arriving now; 0 skips the line.

freight.description: Inbound freight for this delivery, in taka.

customs_duty.description: Customs and import duty for this delivery, in taka.

other_cost.description: Any other landed cost (labour, loading, insurance), in taka.

apportion_method.description: How the landed costs are split across lines; by value when omitted.

costs_paid_to_supplier.description: Whether the supplier charged the landed costs on its invoice (they add to what we owe it). Default true.

costs_vendor.description: Who charged the landed costs when not the supplier (freight forwarder, C&F agent). Only with `costs_paid_to_supplier: false`.

anyOf.description: How they were paid, if already paid; omit when the bill is still open.

ReceivePurchaseRequest.title: ReceivePurchaseRequest

RecommendationPlacement.description: Where a recommendation was shown (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.1 `recommendation_events.placement`). The placement that put a line in the cart travels on `cart_items.recommendation_source` and is stamped onto `order_items.recommendation_source` at checkout (rule 25d), so the P&L can attribute what each placement actually sold. There is deliberately no checkout placement (rule 25b).
RecommendationPlacement.title: RecommendationPlacement

RecordCodReceiptRequest.description:
`POST /finance/orders/{order}/cod-receipts` — cash received from the courier for one
delivered COD order: `amount` (> 0, ≤ outstanding), `received_on` (a Dhaka date, not in
the future), optional `reference` (the courier's payment id) and `note`. Needs
finance.reconcile_cod and an `Idempotency-Key`.
RecordCodReceiptRequest.title: RecordCodReceiptRequest

RejectHeldOrderRequest.description:
`POST /risk/orders/{order}/reject` — a person cancels a held order: `reason` (a
CancellationReason, required) and `note` (required for `other`). Needs risk.verify AND
orders.cancel. The only cancel the queue has — scoring never cancels (rule 23).
RejectHeldOrderRequest.title: RejectHeldOrderRequest

RejectRefundRequest.description: `POST /refunds/{refund}/reject` — same permission as approving it; a reason is required.
RejectRefundRequest.title: RejectRefundRequest

RejectReturnRequest.description: `POST /returns/{orderReturn}/reject` — needs returns.manage; a reason is required.
RejectReturnRequest.title: RejectReturnRequest

RejectStockAdjustmentRequest.description: `POST /inventory/adjustments/{adjustment}/reject` — needs inventory.approve_adjustments. Writes no movement; the reason is required.
RejectStockAdjustmentRequest.title: RejectStockAdjustmentRequest

RelationType.description: `product_relations.type` (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.1). `age_progression` is its own type, not a flavour of upsell: an upsell is a better version of the same toy; an age progression is the next toy, for a child who has outgrown this one.
RelationType.title: RelationType

ReorderAttributeValuesRequest.description:
`POST /attributes/{attribute}/values/reorder` — `{ ids: [3, 1, 2] }`, every value
id of the attribute exactly once, in the new display order.
ReorderAttributeValuesRequest.title: ReorderAttributeValuesRequest

ReorderCmsBlocksRequest.description: `PUT /content/home/order` — `ids`: every draft block id, in the new order.
ReorderCmsBlocksRequest.title: ReorderCmsBlocksRequest

ReorderProductImagesRequest.description:
`POST /products/{product}/images/reorder` — `{ ids: [3, 1, 2] }`, every image id
of the product exactly once, in display order. Needs catalog.update.
ReorderProductImagesRequest.title: ReorderProductImagesRequest

ReorderTestimonialsRequest.description: `POST /content/testimonials/reorder` — `ids`: every testimonial id, once, in the new order.
ReorderTestimonialsRequest.title: ReorderTestimonialsRequest

ReplaceMediaRequest.description:
`POST /media/{media}/replace` — `multipart/form-data`, `file` of the same kind as the
media (image ↔ image, PDF ↔ PDF), ≤ 10 MB, checked by content. Needs media.manage.
ReplaceMediaRequest.title: ReplaceMediaRequest

ReplyToReviewRequest.description: `PUT /reviews/{review}/reply` — the shop's public reply; null or "" removes it. Needs reviews.moderate.
ReplyToReviewRequest.title: ReplyToReviewRequest

RequestOtpRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/auth/otp` (P4-STO-11) — text a sign-in code. Called by the Next.js
server with its storefront token; the route's ability authorises it.
RequestOtpRequest.title: RequestOtpRequest

RequestShipmentRequest.description:
`POST /orders/{order}/shipments` — send one order to a courier (P6, DATABASE-DESIGN §4.2).
Needs orders.update + shipments.book; `Idempotency-Key` required (rule 17).

provider.description: Courier provider code (e.g. `steadfast`, `pathao`). Omitted: the active default provider.

courier_location_id.description: A mapped `courier_locations` id of that provider — required in effect when the address's upazila maps to several zones (rule 32).

weight_grams.description: Parcel weight in grams, overriding Σ variant weight × quantity.

RequestShipmentRequest.title: RequestShipmentRequest

RestoreCartRequest.description: `POST /cart/restore` `{token}` — the token from a recovery SMS link (P7).
RestoreCartRequest.title: RestoreCartRequest

ReturnReason.description: Why a customer sent goods back. Counted by cause, so a fixed list; `other` needs a note.
ReturnReason.title: ReturnReason

RevertCmsLayoutRequest.description:
`POST /content/home/versions/{version}/revert` — `publish` (default true) puts the old
version live again as a new version; false only restores it into the draft.
RevertCmsLayoutRequest.title: RevertCmsLayoutRequest

ReviewSettlementLineRequest.title: ReviewSettlementLineRequest

RobotsDirective.description: The robots meta values the admin may choose (SeoPanel "Advanced").
RobotsDirective.title: RobotsDirective

SaveRedirectRequest.description:
`POST /seo/redirects` and `PATCH /seo/redirects/{redirect}`. Shape only; the
conflict, loop and chain rules live in App\Domain\Seo\Actions\SaveRedirect.
SaveRedirectRequest.title: SaveRedirectRequest

SaveSeoMetaRequest.description:
`PUT /seo/meta/{type}/{id}` — the whole SEO document of one page (SeoPanel). Every text
field is optional (empty = the server default); a save replaces the stored document.
SaveSeoMetaRequest.title: SaveSeoMetaRequest

SendTestSmsRequest.description:
`POST /settings/messaging/test` — one test SMS to a Bangladeshi mobile (rule 30:
013–019 only), in English or Bangla; needs settings.manage_integrations.
SendTestSmsRequest.title: SendTestSmsRequest

serp.description: Search-result previews, computed on the server.

SeoMeasureRequest.description:
`POST /products/seo-measure` — the server's pixel measurement of an unsaved meta
title and description (the SeoPanel meters). Read-only; needs catalog.view.
SeoMeasureRequest.title: SeoMeasureRequest

SerpPreviewRequest.description: `POST /seo/serp-preview` — the server's truncation of unsaved title/description. Read-only.
SerpPreviewRequest.title: SerpPreviewRequest

SetCartContactRequest.description:
`PUT /cart/contact` `{phone, marketing_consent, locale?}` (P7 abandoned-cart recovery).
`marketing_consent` is the shopper's explicit opt-in to one reminder about this cart.
SetCartContactRequest.title: SetCartContactRequest

SetPhoneStatusRequest.description:
`PUT /risk/phone-status` — put a phone on a list (or back to normal): `phone`, `status`
(normal|watch|blacklist|whitelist) and a `reason` (required, recorded with who and when).
Blacklisting also needs `confirm` equal to the phone's last four digits (the checklist's
typed confirmation). Needs risk.manage_lists.
SetPhoneStatusRequest.title: SetPhoneStatusRequest

ShipOrderRequest.description:
`POST /orders/{order}/ship` — manual dispatch (P5, until Phase 6 courier booking).
Needs orders.update + shipments.book. Both courier fields are free text and optional:
a self-delivery has neither.

courier_name.description: Courier the parcel was handed to, booked outside the system (e.g. "Pathao", "own rider").

tracking_reference.description: The courier's consignment or tracking reference, as printed on its receipt.

note.description: Shown on the order's activity timeline next to the change.

ShipOrderRequest.title: ShipOrderRequest

failure_code.description: machine-readable: unverified_provider, inactive_provider, unmapped_location, ambiguous_location, provider_refused, transport, order_not_shippable, completion_failed

needs_attention.description: In the retry queue: failed, or booked with the courier but the order not yet marked shipped.

dispatched.description: The order was marked shipped for this shipment (stock consumed, courier charge booked).

ShipmentLabelsRequest.description:
`GET /shipments/{shipment}/label` and `POST /shipments/labels` — shipping label PDFs.
Needs shipments.view AND customers.view_pii: the label carries the full phone and street
address the courier needs (rule 20, like the packing slip). `locale` picks the label's
printed captions (default English; the address is printed as the customer typed it).
ShipmentLabelsRequest.title: ShipmentLabelsRequest

totals.description: Per courier, over the orders it can price.

ShipmentQuoteRequest.description:
`POST /shipments/quote` — the booking panel's charge preview for one order (single) or up
to 100 (bulk), for every courier, from the stored rate cards. Read-only; needs the same
powers as booking (orders.update + shipments.book). `weight_grams` overrides the summed
variant weight for that order ("Override if you weighed the parcel").

weight_grams.description: Parcel weight in grams; absent = Σ variant weight × quantity.

ShipmentQuoteRequest.title: ShipmentQuoteRequest

error.description: The provider's refusal, as it gave it.

SslcommerzNotificationRequest.description:
An SSLCommerz IPN, or the browser-return POST forwarded by the storefront (P4-PAY-03).

Validation here is shape only (bounded scalar strings) — it parses nothing into a domain
object and writes nothing. The signature is verified on the raw fields
({@see raw()}) before anything else happens (rule 19); everything that moves money comes
from re-querying SSLCommerz, never from these fields.
SslcommerzNotificationRequest.title: SslcommerzNotificationRequest

StockAdjustmentReason.description: `stock_adjustments.reason` (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.2), plus `gift_sample` — stock given away as a gift, giveaway or influencer sample, which is a real outflow but neither a loss nor a sale — and `theft` (P5-INV), a loss kept apart from `loss` so shrinkage by theft is reportable on its own. Each reason fixes the direction it may move stock and the movement type it writes: damage → damage_out; loss, theft, expiry, gift/sample → adjustment_out; found → adjustment_in; a recount or a correction may go either way.  Damage, loss, theft and expiry are write-offs: the units are gone with no sale, so Finance books their weighted-average cost as an `inventory_write_off` expense (StockWrittenOff). A gift/sample is a marketing cost, not a write-off, and is left for the expense module.
StockAdjustmentReason.title: StockAdjustmentReason

StoreAttributeRequest.description:
`POST /attributes`. `type` is `select` (default), `color` (values carry a swatch)
or `text`. When `slug` is omitted it is generated from `name` (or `name_bn`).
StoreAttributeRequest.title: StoreAttributeRequest

StoreAttributeValueRequest.description:
`POST /attributes/{attribute}/values`. `slug` is unique within the attribute and
generated from `value` when omitted. `color_hex` (`#RRGGBB`) is kept only for a
colour-type attribute.
StoreAttributeValueRequest.title: StoreAttributeValueRequest

StoreBrandRequest.description:
`POST /brands`. When `slug` is omitted it is generated from `name` (or `name_bn`),
ASCII-transliterated (rule 37) and made unique.
StoreBrandRequest.title: StoreBrandRequest

StoreCategoryRequest.description:
`POST /categories`. Appended as the last child of `parent_id` (omit or null for a
root). When `slug` is omitted it is generated from `name` (or `name_bn`). At most
three levels deep; an active category under an archived parent is a 409.
StoreCategoryRequest.title: StoreCategoryRequest

StoreCmsBlockRequest.description:
`POST /content/home/blocks` — add a block to the draft. `content` is optional: omitted, the
type's defaults are used; given, it is validated against the type's schema. `position` is the
0-based slot (omitted = the end).
StoreCmsBlockRequest.title: StoreCmsBlockRequest

StoreComplianceCertificateRequest.description:
`POST /products/{product}/compliance/certificate` — `multipart/form-data` with `file`:
the BSTI certificate as a PDF (by content, ≤ 10 MB, no scripts or attachments).
Replaces any previous certificate. Needs catalog.update.
StoreComplianceCertificateRequest.title: StoreComplianceCertificateRequest

StoreMediaRequest.description:
`POST /media` — `multipart/form-data`, one file: an image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF) or a
PDF, by content, ≤ 10 MB; optional `folder_id`, `alt_text`, `alt_text_bn`, `caption`.
Needs media.manage.
StoreMediaRequest.title: StoreMediaRequest

StoreNotificationTemplateRequest.description:
`POST /notifications/templates` — a staff-made template (P7 Message templates) for
marketing or manual use; needs settings.update. `variables` is a subset of the generic
set ({@see CustomTemplateVariables::ALL}); the bodies may name only those. One row is
created per channel, sharing a generated `custom.*` key. Subjects are required when
email is one of the channels.
StoreNotificationTemplateRequest.title: StoreNotificationTemplateRequest

is_customer_visible.description: Private by default; true lets the customer's tracking page show it.

StoreOrderRequest.description:
`POST /orders` — a phone / Facebook / WhatsApp order keyed in by staff (P4-ORD-06).
Needs orders.create and an `Idempotency-Key`. Payment is cash on delivery (the only
driver until a gateway is chosen, Gate 1 decision 5). `expected_total` is the total
from `POST /orders/quote` that the operator read to the customer.

customer_note.description: Printed on the packing slip (e.g. "gift wrap please").

internal_note.description: Staff only — never shown to the customer.

StoreOrderRequest.title: StoreOrderRequest

StoreProductImageRequest.description:
`POST /products/{product}/images` — `multipart/form-data`: `file` (JPEG, PNG, WebP
or AVIF by content, ≤ 10 MB, ≤ 8000 px per side), optional `alt_text`,
`alt_text_bn`, `variant_id`, and an optional `crop[x|y|width|height]` rectangle
in the source image's (EXIF-oriented) pixels. Needs catalog.update.

Or, instead of `file`, a `media_id` (JSON or multipart): attach an existing library
image (docs/api/media-library.md). `crop` is not allowed with it.

file.description: Either a new file or an existing library image (docs/api/media-library.md).

StoreProductImageRequest.title: StoreProductImageRequest

StoreProductImportRequest.description:
`POST /product-imports` — a CSV (UTF-8, with or without BOM) or XLSX file of up to
10 MB, in the columns of a product export. Needs catalog.import. The file is only
stored here; its rows are checked by the queued preview.
StoreProductImportRequest.title: StoreProductImportRequest

StoreProductRequest.description:
`POST /products` — needs catalog.create. Setting the initial prices is part of
creating; a `cost_price` anywhere in the document needs catalog.view_cost.
When `slug` is omitted it is generated from `name` (or `name_bn`).
`variants[i].opening_stock` > 0 also needs inventory.adjust.

specifications.description: Label → value pairs ("Material" → "ABS plastic"), a JSON object.

opening_stock.description:
Opening stock is set once, at creation (an `opening_balance` movement). After
that, stock changes only through purchases, sales and adjustments (Phase 5).

sales_channels.description: Where the product is sold. Omitted: keep the current flags.

vat_rate.description:
VAT included in the selling price, percent as a decimal string ("0", "15").
Omitted or null: keep the current rate.

compliance.description: BSTI certification. Omitted: keep the current values. The PDF is uploaded separately.

seo.description: Search & social (seo_meta). Omitted: keep the current values; sent: replaces them.

schema_override.description: JSON-LD merged over the generated Product schema; a JSON object.

acknowledge_slug_redirect.description:
Required (true) to change the slug of a published product: the old URL then
301s to the new one (slug_history).

StoreProductRequest.title: StoreProductRequest

StorePurchaseRequest.description: `POST /purchases` — raises a draft PO; needs purchasing.create.

location_id.description: The stock location the goods are expected at; the default location when omitted.

unit_cost.description: The supplier's price per unit, up to 4 decimals.

discount.description: Discount on the whole line, in taka.

StorePurchaseRequest.title: StorePurchaseRequest

StoreReturnRequest.description:
`POST /orders/{order}/returns` — needs returns.manage. Quantities are checked against
what is still returnable on each line by RequestReturn, under the order's row lock.

refund_shipping.description: Also refund the delivery charge (at most once per order).

StoreReturnRequest.title: StoreReturnRequest

StoreStockAdjustmentRequest.description:
`POST /inventory/adjustments` — needs inventory.adjust and an `Idempotency-Key`
(a double-submitted adjustment would move the stock twice).

Each line names a variant and EITHER `quantity` (a signed change, never 0: -2 for two
damaged units) OR `counted` (what a stock count found; the server works out the
change under the row lock). Which way a reason may move stock, and that on hand never
drops below what is reserved, is checked by AdjustStock against the locked row.

location_id.description: The stock location; the default location when omitted.

quantity.description: Signed change in units (e.g. -2). Omit when sending `counted`.

counted.description: The on-hand quantity a stock count found. Omit when sending `quantity`.

StoreStockAdjustmentRequest.title: StoreStockAdjustmentRequest

StoreStockTransferRequest.description:
`POST /inventory/transfers` — needs inventory.transfer and an `Idempotency-Key` (a
double-submitted transfer would move the stock twice). Each line names a variant and
the units to move (> 0). That the source has them AVAILABLE (on hand minus reserved)
is checked by TransferStock against the locked rows, never here.

to_location_id.description: Where they arrive; must differ from the source.

StoreStockTransferRequest.title: StoreStockTransferRequest

StoreSupplierPaymentRequest.description:
`POST /suppliers/{supplier}/payments` — needs finance.record_supplier_payments and an
`Idempotency-Key` (a double-submitted payment would pay twice on the books).

paid_at.description: The Dhaka date the money left, Y-m-d; never in the future.

purchase_id.description: The PO this pays against, if any (must belong to this supplier).

StoreSupplierPaymentRequest.title: StoreSupplierPaymentRequest

opening_balance.description: What we already owed the supplier at go-live (negative = an advance they hold).

name.description: Empty until the customer adds it (OTP sign-up asks only for the phone).

token.description: Sanctum bearer token for `/storefront/account/*`. Shown once.

stage.description: Customer-facing status code; localise the label in the storefront.

payment.description:
`next_action` is null for cash on delivery; for an online order whose live
gateway session is still open it is `{type: "redirect", url}`. `retry_allowed`:
the payment-failed page may offer `POST /orders/{number}/payment` again.
`expires_at`: when the unpaid online order's stock hold lapses (null for COD).

shipment.description:
The courier leg (P6): the order's latest shipment a courier has accepted, or null
before that (a booking still pending or refused is staff business, never shown).
`milestones` are the courier's, oldest first, each the latest time it was reached;
`consignment_id` is null while a bulk booking awaits the courier's id (rule 24d).
`tracking_url` is the courier's own public page.

breadcrumbs.description:
The primary category's path, root first, ending with the primary category.
Empty when that category is archived.

description.description:
Sanitised rich-text HTML: p, h2, h3, strong, em, ul, ol, li, blockquote, br,
a[href] and img[src, alt, width, height] from our own media only.

description_bn.description:
Sanitised rich-text HTML: p, h2, h3, strong, em, ul, ol, li, blockquote, br,
a[href] and img[src, alt, width, height] from our own media only.

specifications.description:
Free-form key/value pairs from the product's specifications, in their stored
order; empty values are dropped.

in_stock.description: True when at least one variant has stock.

flash_sale.description:
P7: the running flash sale on this product — the cheapest offer, plus each
variant's own sale price in `variants` (variant id → offer). Null when none.

in_stock.description:
An active variant has available stock (on_hand − reserved > 0). Sold-out
cards stay listed and show their out-of-stock state.

flash_sale.description:
P7: the cheapest running flash-sale offer on this product (badge + countdown to
`ends_at`, server time UTC), or null. Display only; the cart prices it.

locale.description: The language the shopper wrote in.

admin_reply.description: The shop's public reply, if any.

SubmitReviewRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/account/reviews` (P4-CAT-12) — the signed-in customer reviews a
live product. `order_item_id` is optional; when given it must be a delivered line
of this customer's own order for the product. `is_verified_purchase` is
prohibited: verification is derived on the server, never claimed by a client.

reviewer_name.description: The name shown on the review; defaults to the first name and last initial ("Nusrat J.").

SubmitReviewRequest.title: SubmitReviewRequest

balance.description: Payables, decimal strings: opening + received − paid = balance (negative = advance). finance.view only.

SupplierPaymentMethod.description: `supplier_payments.method` — how the money left the business.
SupplierPaymentMethod.title: SupplierPaymentMethod

SupplierStatus.description: `suppliers.status`. Archived, never deleted: purchases and payments reference it.
SupplierStatus.title: SupplierStatus

UpdateAttributeRequest.description:
`PATCH /attributes/{attribute}` — every field optional; only the fields sent
change. Changing `type` away from `color` clears the values' swatches.
UpdateAttributeRequest.title: UpdateAttributeRequest

UpdateBrandRequest.description:
`PATCH /brands/{brand}` — every field optional; only the fields sent change.
`slug: null` (or omitted) keeps the current slug: a rename never moves the URL.
`is_active: true` restores an archived brand.
UpdateBrandRequest.title: UpdateBrandRequest

UpdateCartItemRequest.description: `PATCH /cart/items/{item}` `{ quantity }` — 1…99; remove a line with DELETE.
UpdateCartItemRequest.title: UpdateCartItemRequest

UpdateCategoryRequest.description:
`PATCH /categories/{category}` — every field optional; only the fields sent
change. `slug: null` (or omitted) keeps the current slug. The parent and order
change only through `POST /categories/{category}/move`.
UpdateCategoryRequest.title: UpdateCategoryRequest

UpdateCmsBlockRequest.description:
`PATCH /content/home/blocks/{block}` — any subset of label, visibility, schedule and
`content`. `content` replaces the block's content whole and is validated against the block's
own type; the type cannot change.
UpdateCmsBlockRequest.title: UpdateCmsBlockRequest

UpdateCourierCredentialsRequest.description:
`PUT /settings/couriers/{provider}/credentials` — needs settings.manage_integrations.
`credentials` maps a key from the provider's `credential_fields` to a new value; an absent
or blank value KEEPS the stored one. `clear` lists keys to remove. `webhook_secret` /
`clear_webhook_secret` work the same way. Nothing is ever echoed back (rule 20).

webhook_secret.description: The shared secret the courier sends with each webhook. Blank keeps it.

UpdateCourierCredentialsRequest.title: UpdateCourierCredentialsRequest

UpdateCourierProviderRequest.description:
`PATCH /settings/couriers/{provider}` — switch a courier on/off or make it the default;
needs shipments.manage_rates. The default provider's rate card prices the storefront, so
the default cannot be switched off (make another default first) and neither can the last
active provider.

is_default.description: Only `true` is meaningful: make this the default (it also switches it on).

UpdateCourierProviderRequest.title: UpdateCourierProviderRequest

UpdateCourierRatesRequest.description:
`PUT /settings/couriers/{provider}/rates` — the whole rate card; needs
shipments.manage_rates. Money is a decimal string (DECIMAL(14,2), never a float — rule 6).
`included_weight_grams` is the weight the base charge covers; `per_kg_charge` is added
per started kilogram above it (Steadfast steps at 1,000 g, Pathao at 2,000 g — rule 32a).

base_charge_dhaka.description: Customer-facing delivery charge, inside Dhaka metro. Decimal string, e.g. "70.00".

included_weight_grams.description: Grams covered by the base charge: 1000 for Steadfast, 2000 for Pathao. Whole 100 g steps.

cod_fee_percent.description: The courier's cash-collection fee, percent of the COD amount, e.g. "1.00".

return_charge.description: What the courier charges to bring a refused parcel back.

UpdateCourierRatesRequest.title: UpdateCourierRatesRequest

UpdateDeliverySettingsRequest.description:
`PUT /settings/delivery` — the store-level free-delivery threshold; needs
shipments.manage_rates. null switches free delivery off. Decimal string (rule 6).

free_shipping_threshold.description: Subtotal at or above which delivery is free, e.g. "3000.00"; null = off.

UpdateDeliverySettingsRequest.title: UpdateDeliverySettingsRequest

UpdateMediaRequest.description:
`PATCH /media/{media}` — any of `alt_text`, `alt_text_bn` (≤ 255), `caption` (≤ 500),
`folder_id` (a folder id or null). Only the keys present change. Needs media.manage.
UpdateMediaRequest.title: UpdateMediaRequest

UpdateMessagingSettingsRequest.description:
`PUT /settings/messaging` — Admin → Integrations → Messaging; needs
settings.manage_integrations. Non-secret fields are the whole document. A blank or
absent `reve_api_key` / `reve_secret_key` KEEPS the saved secret; `clear_reve_api_key`
/ `clear_reve_secret_key` remove it (env applies again, if set). Choosing `reve` needs
a base URL, a sender ID and both secrets to be in place after the save.

reve_sender_id.description: The REVE non-masking number: digits only (5–15), optional leading `+`.

sms_cost_per_segment.description: Decimal string, taka per segment, ≥ 0 (no sign allowed), 2 places at most.

UpdateMessagingSettingsRequest.title: UpdateMessagingSettingsRequest

UpdateNotificationPreferencesRequest.description:
`PUT /notifications/customers/{customer}/preferences` — one or more (channel, category)
switches; needs customers.update. `security` is not accepted: OTP cannot be opted out of.
UpdateNotificationPreferencesRequest.title: UpdateNotificationPreferencesRequest

name_en.description: Custom (staff-made) templates only; ignored for a system template (P7).

UpdateNotificationTemplateRequest.title: UpdateNotificationTemplateRequest

UpdateOrderRequest.description:
`PUT /orders/{order}` and `POST /orders/{order}/edit-quote` — edit a placed order
(P4-ORD-07). Needs orders.update. The body is the whole editable state: every line
the order should have afterwards (one left out is removed), the recipient and the
address. `expected_total` (required to save, ignored by the quote) is the re-quoted
total the operator was shown.

note.description: Why the order was edited — shown on the activity timeline.

UpdateOrderRequest.title: UpdateOrderRequest

UpdateProductImageRequest.description:
`PATCH /products/{product}/images/{image}` — any of `alt_text`, `alt_text_bn`,
`variant_id` (null detaches), `is_primary` (`true` only). Needs catalog.update.
UpdateProductImageRequest.title: UpdateProductImageRequest

UpdateProductRequest.description:
`PUT /products/{product}` — needs catalog.update. The whole document, variant
matrix included; `slug` null (or omitted) keeps the current slug, `relations`
omitted keeps the curated relations, `cost_price` omitted keeps a variant's cost.

Field-level abilities, enforced where the domain sees what changes (403 otherwise):
changing a selling price or adding a variant needs catalog.update_price; sending
any `cost_price` needs catalog.view_cost.

specifications.description: Label → value pairs ("Material" → "ABS plastic"), a JSON object.

opening_stock.description:
Opening stock is set once, at creation (an `opening_balance` movement). After
that, stock changes only through purchases, sales and adjustments (Phase 5).

sales_channels.description: Where the product is sold. Omitted: keep the current flags.

vat_rate.description:
VAT included in the selling price, percent as a decimal string ("0", "15").
Omitted or null: keep the current rate.

compliance.description: BSTI certification. Omitted: keep the current values. The PDF is uploaded separately.

seo.description: Search & social (seo_meta). Omitted: keep the current values; sent: replaces them.

schema_override.description: JSON-LD merged over the generated Product schema; a JSON object.

acknowledge_slug_redirect.description:
Required (true) to change the slug of a published product: the old URL then
301s to the new one (slug_history).

UpdateProductRequest.title: UpdateProductRequest

UpdateProfileRequest.description: `PATCH /storefront/account` — the customer's own name, email and language.
UpdateProfileRequest.title: UpdateProfileRequest

UpdatePurchaseRequest.description: `PUT /purchases/{purchase}` — replaces a draft's header and lines (409 once ordered); needs purchasing.create.

location_id.description: The stock location the goods are expected at; the default location when omitted.

unit_cost.description: The supplier's price per unit, up to 4 decimals.

discount.description: Discount on the whole line, in taka.

UpdatePurchaseRequest.title: UpdatePurchaseRequest

UpdateRiskRulesRequest.description:
`PUT /risk/rules` — the Risk rules form: one weight per factor (0–100, totalling ≤ 100 so
the breakdown always adds up to the score), `medium_threshold` < `high_threshold` (1–100),
`first_order_hold_threshold` (BDT, rule 33b), `value_norm_multiplier` (1–20) and
`rapid_repeat_minutes` (1–1440). Needs risk.manage_rules.
UpdateRiskRulesRequest.title: UpdateRiskRulesRequest

UpdateRobotsRequest.description: `PUT /seo/robots` — the robots.txt text, validated directive by directive. seo.manage.
UpdateRobotsRequest.title: UpdateRobotsRequest

UpdateShipmentRiderRequest.description:
`PATCH /shipments/{shipment}/rider` — the delivery rider's name and phone, typed in when the
rider calls (neither courier's API returns them). Both null clears the rider. The phone is
a Bangladeshi mobile, 013–019 only (rule 30), stored E.164. Needs shipments.book.

rider_name.description: The rider's name as they gave it.

UpdateShipmentRiderRequest.title: UpdateShipmentRiderRequest

UpdateSupplierRequest.description:
`PATCH /suppliers/{supplier}` — every field optional; only the fields sent change.
`status: active` restores an archived supplier. Needs purchasing.manage_suppliers.
UpdateSupplierRequest.title: UpdateSupplierRequest

UpdateWhatsAppStatusRequest.description:
`PUT /notifications/templates/{template}/whatsapp-status` (P7) — staff record where a
WhatsApp template stands with Meta; needs settings.update. No Meta API is called.
UpdateWhatsAppStatusRequest.title: UpdateWhatsAppStatusRequest

VariantStatus.description: `product_variants.status`. A variant is archived, never deleted: stock movements and order lines reference it.
VariantStatus.title: VariantStatus

VerifyHeldOrderRequest.description:
`POST /risk/orders/{order}/verify` — optional `note`. Verifying confirms the order
(on_hold → confirmed), so it needs risk.verify AND orders.confirm.
VerifyHeldOrderRequest.title: VerifyHeldOrderRequest

VerifyOtpRequest.description:
`POST /storefront/auth/otp/verify` (P4-STO-11). An optional `X-Cart-Token` names the
guest cart to merge into the customer's cart on sign-in.
VerifyOtpRequest.title: VerifyOtpRequest

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated unique key (a UUID v4 is ideal), 8–255 printable ASCII characters. Retrying with the same key and body replays the stored 2xx response for 24h with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different body is 422 `idempotency-key-reused`; while the first request runs, 409 `request-in-progress`.
